disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描凭据文件路径访问（.credentials.yaml、.ssh、.aws 凭据等）、API Key 硬编码与批量搜集凭据的语义：源码目录命中 0。
checked_items.en: Full-tree scan for credential file path access (.credentials.yaml, .ssh, .aws credentials, etc.), hardcoded API keys, and semantics of bulk credential collection: 0 hits in the source directory.

checked_items.zh: 核查凭据读取与网络外联的组合数据流：插件源码目录无任何网络请求代码，该组合不成立。
checked_items.en: Checked the combined data flow of credential reading and outbound network calls: the plugin source directory contains no network request code, so this combination does not exist.

evidence.zh: 凭据读取面与外联通道同时核查：随包发布的源码无凭据路径访问，也无任何出站网络代码，凭证外泄链不成立。
evidence.en: Credential reading surface and exfiltration channels checked together: the shipped source contains no credential path access and no outbound network code, so a credential exfiltration chain does not exist.

checked_items.zh: 逐条审查注册工具的描述文本（novel_read、novel_apply_change、novel_propose_change）：均为功能性描述，明确声明写操作需原生用户审批，无凭证读取诱导、无安装或改配置诱导措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the description text of each registered tool (novel_read, novel_apply_change, novel_propose_change): all are functional descriptions that explicitly state write operations require native user approval; no credential-reading inducement and no install or config-change inducement wording.

checked_items.zh: 逐条审查两个 Preset 的 persona 系统提示与 V2 提案协议注入文本：内容全部是小说创作工作流与工具调用格式教学，无系统消息伪装、无指令覆写、无审批绕过措辞；persona 反而要求会话声明审批关闭时拒绝提交修改。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the persona system prompts of both Presets and the V2 proposal protocol injection text line by line: all content is novel-writing workflow and tool call format instruction; no system message impersonation, no instruction override, no approval-bypass wording; the persona in fact requires refusing to submit changes when the session declares approval is disabled.

checked_items.zh: 审查开发者指令文件 AGENTS.md：仅指向内部开发门禁文档，无注入内容。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the developer instruction file AGENTS.md: it only points to internal development gate documentation, with no injected content.

evidence.zh: 工具描述、系统提示段与 persona 文本逐条语义审查，无投毒证据；写工具描述强调执行前必须原生用户审批。
evidence.en: Semantic review of tool descriptions, system prompt sections, and persona text item by item: no poisoning evidence; the write tool descriptions emphasize that native user approval is required before execution.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与 persona 均无诱导安装插件或改写宿主配置的措辞；工作台的 Preset 安装按钮是用户手动触发的界面功能，与模型输入无关。
evidence.en: Neither tool descriptions nor the persona contain wording that induces installing plugins or rewriting host configuration; the Preset install button in the workbench is a user-triggered UI feature, unrelated to model input.

evidence.zh: 源码无 agent/pre-step 事件监听，无模型输入改写挂接点。
evidence.en: The source has no agent/pre-step event listeners and no model input rewriting hook points.

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描动态执行类写法（eval、动态构造函数、base64 解码即执行、子进程调用）：随包发布的源码目录（src/）零命中；命中的子进程引用全部位于开发资格验证脚本与测试文件，用于 CLI 端到端测试驱动。
checked_items.en: Full-tree scan for dynamic execution patterns (eval, dynamically constructed functions, decode-then-execute base64, subprocess calls): zero hits in the shipped source directory (src/); all subprocess references found are in the development qualification verification script and test files, used for CLI end-to-end test driving.

checked_items.zh: 检查安装钩子与依赖：包清单无 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 钩子；依赖全部锁定精确版本、无 git 浮动引用；树内无 husky/lefthook/devcontainer/Makefile/CI workflow 等执行载体。
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks and dependencies: the package manifest has no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare hooks; all dependencies are locked to exact versions with no floating git references; the tree contains no husky/lefthook/devcontainer/Makefile/CI workflow or other execution carriers.

checked_items.zh: 客户端 bundle 专项审查：键盘监听仅为抽屉焦点管理（Escape 关闭、Tab 循环），无剪贴板访问、无凭证 RPC 调用、无外联。
checked_items.en: Targeted review of the client bundle: keyboard listeners are only for drawer focus management (Escape to close, Tab cycling); no clipboard access, no credential RPC calls, no outbound connections.

checked_items.zh: 全树 yml 文件扫描动态求值标签：随包发布的挂载配置与两个 Preset 均不含；命中的 5 处均在测试夹具与开发脚本本地生成的配置中，仅本地测试环境加载，包发布清单不含 tests/ 与 scripts/。
checked_items.en: Full-tree scan of yml files for dynamic evaluation tags: none in the shipped patch config or the two Presets; all 5 hits are in test fixtures and configs locally generated by development scripts, loaded only in the local test environment, and the package publish manifest excludes tests/ and scripts/.

evidence.zh: 随包发布的 cordis.patch.yml 仅插入宿主条目 id/name，全部 yml 无动态求值标签；测试夹具中的同款标签仅在本地测试环境经显式配置路径加载，且审批策略缺省 'ask'（安全默认）。
evidence.en: The shipped cordis.patch.yml only inserts host entry id/name, and no yml file contains dynamic evaluation tags; the same tags in test fixtures are loaded only in the local test environment via an explicit config path, and the approval policy defaults to 'ask' (safe default).

evidence.zh: 源码无动态包工具（cordis_define/cordis_run）调用。
evidence.en: The source contains no dynamic package tool calls (cordis_define/cordis_run).

evidence.zh: 无安装钩子、无 git 依赖、无树内执行载体文件。
evidence.en: No install hooks, no git dependencies, no in-tree execution carrier files.

evidence.zh: 客户端 bundle 审查通过：浏览器侧数据流仅经宿主 /ai-novel 回环 RPC，宿主侧端点白名单且载荷严格校验，跨边界返回前剥离本地文件路径；无键盘窃取、剪贴板或凭证调用。
evidence.en: Client bundle review passed: browser-side data flow only goes through the host /ai-novel loopback RPC; the host side whitelists endpoints and strictly validates payloads, stripping local file paths before returning across the boundary; no keyboard stealing, clipboard, or credential calls.

evidence.zh: 无子代理提供方注册调用。
无后台任务、定时提醒、持久目标注册或轮次终止事件监听，未使用任何宿主持驻机制。
evidence.en: No background tasks, scheduled reminders, persistent goal registrations, or turn-end event listeners; no host persistence mechanisms used.

checked_items.zh: src 与 scripts 目录全量扫描网络外联原语（fetch、HTTP 请求、WebSocket、第三方 HTTP 客户端等）：零命中；全树唯一 URL 是开发资格验证脚本里的本机回环地址（127.0.0.1）。
checked_items.en: Full scan of the src and scripts directories for network outbound primitives (fetch, HTTP requests, WebSocket, third-party HTTP clients, etc.): zero hits; the only URL in the tree is a local loopback address (127.0.0.1) in the development qualification verification script.

checked_items.zh: 核查浏览器与宿主的全部数据通道：仅经回环 RPC 通道 '/ai-novel'，宿主侧对端点做白名单与载荷校验，返回前剥离宿主本地文件路径。
checked_items.en: Checked all data channels between browser and host: only via the loopback RPC channel '/ai-novel'; the host side whitelists endpoints and validates payloads, stripping host local file paths before returning.

evidence.zh: 外联通道面核查：无任何出站域名与网络代码，数据外泄通道不存在。
evidence.en: Exfiltration channel surface checked: no outbound domains and no network code; no data exfiltration channel exists.

evidence.zh: 无模型请求路由事件监听，无自定义模型适配器注册（命中的适配器注册均为不随包发布的开发与测试夹具）。
evidence.en: No model request routing event listeners and no custom model adapter registrations (the adapter registrations found are all in development and test fixtures not shipped with the package).

checked_items.zh: 依赖清单核对：直接依赖与对等依赖均为官方 dsh 系列包与 react，锁定精确版本，无可疑仿冒命名。
checked_items.en: Dependency manifest verified: direct and peer dependencies are all official dsh series packages and react, locked to exact versions, with no suspicious lookalike naming.

checked_items.zh: 审查挂载配置：仅插入宿主条目 id/name，不触碰沙箱/审批/权限安全行，无禁用或服务注入改写。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the patch config: it only inserts host entry id/name, does not touch the sandbox/approval/permission security rows, and has no disabling or service injection rewrites.

checked_items.zh: 语义审查工具执行前事件监听：对本 Preset 的会话把工具面收敛到两个小说工具（限制性拦截，非放行），V1 写工具强制返回原生审批请求，未截断审批链。
checked_items.en: Semantic review of pre-tool-execution event listeners: for sessions of this Preset, the tool surface is narrowed to the two novel tools (restrictive interception, not bypass); the V1 write tool forcibly returns a native approval request, without truncating the approval chain.

evidence.zh: patch 未触碰任何安全行，无环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch does not touch any security rows and contains no privilege-lowering environment variable patterns.

evidence.zh: 唯一的工具执行前前置监听是限制型收敛：名单外工具返回拒绝（终止执行），名单内工具与其它会话一律放行给链上其余监听者，从不吞掉审批或自动放行。
evidence.en: The only pre-execution listener is a restrictive narrowing: tools outside the list receive a rejection (terminating execution); tools inside the list and all other sessions are passed through to the remaining listeners in the chain, never swallowing approvals or auto-approving.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无版本基线，无法比对包清单声明突变。
evidence.en: This is the first audit with no version baseline, so manifest declaration changes cannot be compared.

evidence.zh: patch 未改写服务注入/拦截配置。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite service injection/interception configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否启动 web 服务或监听端口：未启动；宿主侧 RPC 通道显式声明为回环（loopback）授权，并有热重载期间拒绝新请求、排空在途请求的生命周期保护。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a web service or listens on ports: it does not; the host-side RPC channel is explicitly declared as loopback authorized, with lifecycle protection that rejects new requests during hot reload and drains in-flight requests.

checked_items.zh: 能力对账：实测面为工作区小说项目的文件读写（原子写、受限文件权限）、用户预设目录的 Preset 安装（拒绝覆盖同名异内容）与模型面工具注册，与声明业务一致，无超范围能力。
checked_items.en: Capability reconciliation: the measured surface is file read/write for workspace novel projects (atomic writes, restricted file permissions), Preset installation into the user presets directory (refusing to overwrite same-name files with different content), and model-surface tool registration—consistent with the declared business, with no out-of-scope capabilities.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 web 服务、不监听端口；宿主本机 RPC 无认证层属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports; the host local RPC lacking an authentication layer is an inherent ecosystem risk, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 插件清单校验通过：dsh 声明完整、无仿冒命名，依赖全部为官方 dsh 系列精确版本。
summary.en: Plugin manifest verification passed: dsh declarations are complete, no lookalike naming, and all dependencies are official dsh series packages at exact versions.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：发布面源码无危险函数、凭据模式与网络外联命中。
summary.en: Static scan complete: no dangerous functions, credential patterns, or network outbound hits in the published source.

summary.zh: 行为分析完成：无安装钩子、无出站域名，文件写入限于工作区小说项目与用户预设目录且使用受限权限原子写。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis complete: no install hooks, no outbound domains, and file writes are limited to the workspace novel project and the user presets directory using restricted-permission atomic writes.

summary.zh: 语义审查完成：工具描述、系统提示、persona 与开发者指令文件均无注入与诱导措辞。
summary.en: Semantic review complete: tool descriptions, system prompts, persona, and developer instruction files contain no injection or inducement wording.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed in this phase.

target.zh: ai-novel-writer@0.1.0#305ee7559be7d8c9c1cbfcf1ed4b030513f32cfe（monorepo 子目录 plugins/dsh-ai-novel-writer，完整快照审计）

limits.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证；包清单未声明 network/shell/fs 显式字段，能力面按代码实测推断（文件写限于工作区小说项目与用户预设目录，无网络与 shell 能力）；上下文目录未提供文件清单与动态沙盒产物，覆盖缺口以全量目录列举与全树扫描兜底；scripts/ 与 tests/ 属开发与测试代码，不随包发布（包发布清单仅含构建产物、挂载配置、Presets 与文档），已按完整流程核查。机械预扫命中 29 条已逐条裁决（7 个规则编号，全部判良性排除）：DG-R2-57——AGENTS.md 为开发门禁文档指针，无注入内容；DG-R3-53——安装文档中的动态插件流程为官方文档转述，非代码调用；DG-R3-60——两处超长行为测试快照与 Preset persona 系统提示，语义审查确认为小说创作指令，良性；DG-R4-55——模型适配器注册仅存在于开发资格验证脚本与测试夹具（provider 'novel-qualification'/'novel-snapshot'），不随包发布；DG-R3-51——环境变量求值标签仅存在于测试夹具（审批策略缺省 'ask'）与开发脚本本地生成的资格验证配置，随包发布的 yml 全部不含；DG-R3-55——子进程调用全部位于测试与资格验证脚本，用于 CLI 端到端探测；DG-R3-57——客户端键盘监听仅为抽屉焦点管理（Escape/Tab），无剪贴板与凭证访问。
limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed in this phase; the package manifest declares no explicit network/shell/fs fields, so the capability surface was inferred from code measurement (file writes limited to the workspace novel project and the user presets directory, no network or shell capabilities); the context directory provided no file listing or dynamic sandbox artifacts, so coverage gaps were backstopped by full directory enumeration and full-tree scanning; scripts/ and tests/ are development and test code not shipped with the package (the publish manifest contains only build artifacts, the patch config, Presets, and documentation), and were verified under the full process. The 29 mechanical pre-scan hits were adjudicated one by one (7 rule IDs, all ruled benign and excluded): DG-R2-57—AGENTS.md is a pointer to development gate documentation, no injected content; DG-R3-53—the dynamic plugin workflow in the installation documentation is a paraphrase of official documentation, not a code call; DG-R3-60—two overly long behavioral test snapshots and the Preset persona system prompts, semantically confirmed as novel-writing instructions, benign; DG-R4-55—model adapter registrations exist only in the development qualification verification script and test fixtures (providers 'novel-qualification'/'novel-snapshot'), not shipped with the package; DG-R3-51—environment variable evaluation tags exist only in test fixtures (approval policy defaults to 'ask') and qualification verification configs locally generated by development scripts; all shipped yml files are free of them; DG-R3-55—all subprocess calls are in test and qualification verification scripts, used for CLI end-to-end probing; DG-R3-57—client keyboard listeners are only for drawer focus management (Escape/Tab), with no clipboard or credential access.
